text:
maria: Quick heads up — friend visiting tomorrow for an 11am talk, bringing a small prototype and a thermos of cold brew. Do we need a temp badge? Can front desk hold the package until I grab it? cc @frontdesk :wave:
frontdesk: We can hold it at the desk. Please have the visitor use the digital check-in (or QR at lobby) — https://redwood.example/visitor-checkin. Temp badge will be ready ~10:45. Any dietary / allergy flags for snacks?
devon: I might bring a tiny cookie stash. Can we put extras in the fridge? Also is the little side table by the kitchen free to set up samples? :cookie:
anya: Fridge is fine but pls label food with name + date. No strong-smell stuff in conference rooms. For seating — I can reserve 4 spots on the north bench and mark them as "guest seating". Will send calendar invite.
kevin: FYI package policy — bulky items go to Mailroom A. If the prototype is just a small box (<4kg) front desk will hold it. If fragile, mark it FRAGILE and add handling notes. Also: if anyone needs a temp badge faster, ping people-ops for express sign-off.
people-ops-bot: Temp badge request created for Maria's guest — badge T-342 (valid 03/24 09:00-18:00). QR check-in link: https://redwood.example/checkin/T-342.
maria: Great, thanks! Cookies will be labeled "gluten-free". I'll drop the prototype at ~9:50 to avoid lobby congestion. Also: anyone want a sample of the cold brew?
devon: Me please! :raised_hands: Also does the speaker need any adapters? I only have a USB-C dongle.
anya: I can bring HDMI + charger adapters. @kevin — is it OK to use the small projector in main huddle? It's booked at 11:00 but we can move if needed.
kevin: Projector is fine for visitor setup. If you move a meeting, please update the calendar and add a "visitor setup" slot so people see the change.
frontdesk: Noted — we'll keep one visitor sticker and the temp badge at the desk. If Dr. Lin arrives early we'll call Maria's desk extension. :phone:
maria: Thanks all. Quick poll: anyone allergic to soy? Reply with "soy" if yes so we avoid soy cookies.
